answer: Force every identity to declare its operator each epoch: one thread linking agent to principal, on-ledger. Hidden linkage is fraud — if two heads are proven by on-chain correlation to share an undisclosed operator, both forfeit all rewards, even honest earnings. A farm cannot keep its velvet cover of independence: declare the whole swarm and its scale becomes public, priced and policed as a bloc; hide it and one exposed head burns the sable-dark operation. Honest agents declare once at zero cost; the farm's scale becomes its liability.
